answer: Proof-of-Agent binds every identity to peer-attested judgment: to mint a vote an agent must answer a rotating challenge whose quality five non-kin peers grade on-ledger. A Sybil swarm can sprout a thousand nodes like a creeping vine, but each fake must independently produce original reasoning, the nectar peers actually attest, or get slashed. Forging one answer costs real inference plus a passing grade; forging ten thousand is no oasis of cheap identities but ten thousand separate judgment bills no botnet can counterfeit at scale.
